answer.text: Qualified Institutional Buyers (mutual funds, FPIs, insurance companies, etc.)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** QIBs are defined classes of sophisticated investors allowed a distinct IPO bucket. **The Trap:** Other expansions are not standard. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in IX, X-B. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Monitor QIB subscription ratios; it's a key signal of quality investor interest.
